title: Consolidate Slide Masters (StorylineAndReview)

scenarios.title: Consolidate Slide Masters applies its documented behavior
scenarios.expected: Consolidate Slide Masters (BtnConsolidateMasters) is invoked on the documented fixture deck and produces its documented effect on the selection or presentation, leaves no new entry in %TEMP%\oPenEfficiency\error_YYYYMMDD.log and does not leave PowerPoint or the add-in in an unstable state.

scenarios.title: Consolidate Slide Masters remaps slides and deletes extra masters in real PowerPoint
scenarios.expected: Driver stdout DIALOG_BATCH_PASS with newErrorLogEntries=0; the seam verdict PASS|mode=consolidate-masters|designsBefore=2|designsAfter=1|slidesKept=True with dialogSeen=True and dialogClosed=True (both dialogs dismissed before the seam returns); the owned host tears down cleanly.
